lines.text: Jesus warns that stumbling blocks will come, and causing one of these little ones to stumble is worse than a millstone and the sea.
Jesus tells His disciples to rebuke a brother who sins and to forgive him if he repents.
Even if a brother sins against you ten times in a day and repents, you must forgive him, and the apostles ask for increased faith.
The Lord says faith the size of a mustard seed could make a fig tree be uprooted and planted in the sea.
A servant coming in from the field must prepare his master's meal and serve him, and the disciples should call themselves unworthy servants.
